title: Cakefoot
description:
Cakefoot is a precision game on rails that brings arcade action into the modern era. Mix bullet hell, dodge 'em up, and slippery physics, and you get a brand new challenge that is as simple as it is difficult. Easy to learn - hold the button to go forward, let go to drift backward - and tough as nails to complete. Face a relentless barrage of endless combinations of attacks, every level being like sneaking through a machine designed to grind you into a pulp.

 

Now there's an even better Cakefoot with unlockable emojis, player ghosts, leaderboards, replays, and achievements, paired with upgraded graphics and music. Zig + zag your way through four chapters of non-stop action that begs for one more try! Don't forget arcade mode - get as far as you can before time expires, then submit your name to the global scoreboard.

 

CAKE is just the beginning -- beat the game 🏆 and collect all the coins ✨ to unlock BEEF CAKE, BUFFALO BEEF CAKE, and even visual effects, MIRROR and WARPED.

 

Cakefoot is featured on many platforms, including Coolmath Games 🧠 and the ✅ Steam Deck. There are even Cakefoot arcade cabinets 👾 at Wonderville and Indie Darling. Cakefoot is the perfect companion to relentless gaming. Fork it up today!

Cakefoot Features

• 22-level Quest Mode 

• Arcade mode 

• 30+ achievements and detailed stats

• Modular enemy types that combine into endless patterns 

• Auto-save

• Unlock new difficulties, emojis, and visual effects by collecting challenge coins 

• Automatic replay recording

• Runs on Windows, Mac, Linux at 60 FPS in any resolution 

• Supports mouse, keyboard, and gamepad 

• Can run fullscreen, and can be displayed on any monitor in a multi-monitor setup 

• Dynamically resize the window to any dimension 

• Simple JSON syntax for creating and sharinglevels and reskins

• Modifiable source code

 

✨ ✨
description_short: Do you have what it cakes? Cakefoot is a brutal 🤬 precision avoid-em game on rails 👾 with addictive gameplay and fast respawn 😇 Blaze a path through 20+ levels of spikes, fire, bombs, and... lethal fish? 🐡 Then weigh in on the global leaderboards!
